summary: Tyler County tower listed as Chester (Central US, removed) and as Barnum (Loc 2) (FFLA, gone); whether these are one tower is not settled; no build, agency or survey detail found.

facts.status_note: Listed as removed; no source gives a removal date.

town of Chester near US 287 and FM 1745 in northwest Tyler County
evidence.quote: Chester is near the junction of U.S. Highway 287 and Farm Road 1745, thirteen miles northwest of Woodville in extreme northwestern Tyler County.

sources.title: Chester, TX

notes_for_editor: The Central US Chester page has only a header (Tyler County, Removed), with no survey, build or agency detail. Chester may be a second tower or the same as Barnum #16 (Loc 1); the sources do not settle it. The 1949 survey marker for Barnum #16 lies 5.5 miles north of Chester, which fits Loc 1 better than Loc 2, but the Loc 2 coordinates were not checked against any survey. Worth checking the Texas Forest Service tower list if one can be found.
